_note: LegiScan settings. Free tier = 30,000 queries a month. Two bulk full-text searches per run (getSearchRaw, up to 2,000 hits each, no page limit). precise_phrases: frontier wording; every hit becomes a candidate with no title screen. wide_query: anything mentioning AI; titles of bills not seen before go to the AI intent check (grabber/intent.mjs), which drops only a confident 'no'. Caps only delay work to the next run. Proved by grabber/recall-legiscan.mjs against every bill already on the site.
wide_query: "artificial intelligence" OR "machine learning" OR "AI model" OR "AI models" OR "AI system" OR "AI systems"
_note_text: Bill text is downloaded from the legislature's own site (state_link), which costs no LegiScan query. text_fallback_legiscan: if that fails, use LegiScan's copy (one query).
_note_cap: monthly_cap set to 10,000 on 28 Oct 2026: LegiScan's free Public API plan is 10,000 (features page) or 30,000 (homepage) a month; 10,000 is the lower figure. At the cap LegiScan is skipped until next month; the rest of the run continues.
